findings.field_extraction_cross_check: ingestion/cm-matosinhos-agenda-cultural/discovery.mjs's extractMatosinhosEventDetailFacts() reproduces, field-for-field, the values already mechanically verified by research/source-investigations/cm-matosinhos-agenda-cultural-amp-01/evidence/offline-proof.mjs and recorded in offline-proof-output.txt for both sampled events, including the single-instant-vs-multi-day atc_date_start/atc_date_end contrast and the canonical-URL/source_record_id stability cross-check.
findings.source_record_id: PROVEN per investigation.json's field_assessment.source_record_id — the detail page's own permalink slug (independently restated in that same page's <meta name="canonical"> tag). ingestion/cm-matosinhos-agenda-cultural/observation-adapter.mjs derives source_record_id ONLY from that canonical event_url's own /evento/{slug} shape — NEVER from the internal wm:page_id meta tag, which the two retained detail-page fixtures mechanically prove is not unique across distinct events (both are literally 2805).
findings.timezone: Every sampled detail page states atc_date_start/atc_date_end as a full local 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' string AND an explicit IANA atc_timezone ('Europe/Lisbon') directly. Per this project's certainty model (ingestion/observation/contract.mjs) and precedent (ingestion/events-calendar-api/observation-adapter.mjs's deriveDateTime()), this is honestly TZID_QUALIFIED_UNRESOLVED — a named timezone is known, but this project does not perform timezone-offset/DST inference to resolve it to a UTC instant. Never UTC_INSTANT, never FLOATING_LOCAL (that would discard the genuinely-stated timezone).
findings.venue: location_text is read from each event's OWN detail page 'location widget_field' ('Local:' label) — not the listing page's copy of the same fact, and not atc_location (which independently corroborates the identical text on both sampled events, but is not this adapter's primary source). Across the two full detail-page fixtures this yields 2 distinct real venues: 'Teatro Municipal de Matosinhos Constantino Nery' and 'Mosteiro de Leça do Balio'. The two listing-page fixtures additionally carry 12 further distinct real venue strings in their own 'Local:' fields (retained, DIRECT_SOURCE, per field_assessment.venue_location) — parseMatosinhosMusicaListing() surfaces these for discovery/provenance, but observation-adapter.mjs never uses a listing-level location_text as an Observation's own location_text, per this task's explicit instruction to use only each event's own detail page.
findings.price: PARTIAL per field_assessment.price — no dedicated structured price field exists anywhere in the retained markup. extractMatosinhosEventDetailFacts() bounds a deterministic, mechanical extraction of the free-text 'Preços' section within the 'text' widget_field block ONLY when that literal heading is present (detail-quarteto-cordas.html); price_lines is genuinely empty and price_text is honestly null for detail-hospitalarios.html, which states no price information anywhere in its own text.
findings.organizer: atc_organizer is present in the add-to-calendar microformat on both sampled events but is genuinely empty in both — organizer is honestly null, never fabricated. No 'Organização:'-labelled field was found anywhere in the retained evidence (searched directly; absent from both detail-page fixtures).
